in_sanskrit.name: Narender
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of men
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Narender एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Narender is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nara', which means man, and 'indra', the name of the Hindu god of rain, thunder, and power. The name Narender is thus a symbol of power, strength, and leadership among men.
